subject: general
question:
Direction: Choose the correct option for the sentence written in error below.

The quick brown fox jumped over the fence, startling the cat, who then chased he all around the garden until they were both exhausted.

options.text: The quick brown fox jumped over the fence, startling the cat,

solution:
The correct answer is **'who then chased he.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the second part of the given sentence, the pronoun "he" is incorrect.
 
• The pronoun "he" should refer to the fox, but the context indicates it should be "him" to maintain grammatical correctness.
 
• "Him" is the correct objective pronoun to use after the verb "chased".
 
• Correct pronoun usage ensures the sentence is clear and grammatically accurate.

Hence, the correct answer is option 2.

Correct sentence:

 *The quick brown fox jumped over the fence, startling the cat, who then chased him all around the garden until they were both exhausted*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1: "The quick brown fox jumped over the fence, startling the cat," - This part of the sentence is correct and sets up the scenario.
 
• Option 3: "all around the garden" - This part is correct and describes the action taking place in the garden.
 
• Option 4: "until they were both exhausted." - This part correctly concludes the sentence, indicating the result of the chase.
